description: sheets.spreadsheets.developerMetadata.search: POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/developerMetadata:search. Returns all developer metadata matching the specified DataFilter. For more information, see Read, write, and search metadata. If the provided DataFilter represents a DeveloperMetadataLookup object, this will return all DeveloperMetadata entries selected by it. If the DataFilter represents a location in a spreadsheet, this will return all developer metadata associated with locations intersecting that region. Body: vendor SearchDeveloperMetadataRequest JSON, checked against the pinned discovery schema. Runs as a background job; completion preserves the vendor response and names the selected account. key, access_token and oauth_token are refused: the connected account authenticates. Parameters use exact vendor names. See editors_api_coverage.md for scopes, bodies and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Sheets Spreadsheets Developer Metadata Search to returns all developer metadata matching the specified DataFilter in Google Sheets, as the selected connected Google account (POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/developerMetadata:search). Send the vendor SearchDeveloperMetadataRequest body; it is checked against Google's schema. Returns Google's full response.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params names the argument or body field and the vendor rule it broke, including refused key/access_token/oauth_token; gsuite.unknown_account names connected accounts; gsuite.missing_scope requires reconnect; gsuite.auth_expired includes Testing-mode renewal guidance; gsuite.permission_denied, gsuite.not_found and gsuite.rate_limited preserve vendor messages.
